title: Medical Conditions: SCA, Hypothermia, Heat Exhaustion & Dehydration

flashcard_questions.q: A life-threatening emergency where the heart suddenly and unexpectedly stops beating.
Cardiopulmonary resuscitation — an emergency procedure combining chest compressions and rescue breaths to maintain blood flow when the heart stops.
A portable device that delivers an electric shock to restore a normal heart rhythm during cardiac arrest.

flashcard_questions.a: A dangerous drop in body temperature below 35°C, caused by prolonged exposure to cold conditions.
A disruption to the heart rhythm caused by a blow to the chest directly over the heart at a critical moment in the cardiac cycle.
